title: Create a Repository for the Authenticated User

# Create a Repository for the Authenticated User

## Prerequisites

- Must have permission to create repositories for the authenticated user (required scopes vary by visibility: `public_repo` or `repo` to create a public repository; `repo` to create a private repository)

## Method

`POST`

## URL

`https://api.github.com/user/repos`

## Headers

```json
{
  "Accept": "application/json",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
```

## Description

Creates a new repository for the authenticated user. You can control repository visibility and enable/disable features like issues, projects, wiki, discussions, merge strategies, and initialization options.

## Enforcement Rules

- There are **no path parameters** for this endpoint.
- When executing the action, ensure to send **Query Parameters** in the URL as query parameters and **not** in the body. (This endpoint does not document any query parameters.)
- When executing the action, ensure to send **Path Parameters** in the URL and **not** in the body. (This endpoint has none.)

## Required Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type   | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `name`   | string | The name of the repository. Example: `"Team Environment"` |

## Optional Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | A short description of the repository. |
| `homepage` | string | A URL with more information about the repository. |
| `private` | boolean | Whether the repository is private. Default: `false`. |
| `has_issues` | boolean | Whether issues are enabled. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `has_projects` | boolean | Whether projects are enabled. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `has_wiki` | boolean | Whether the wiki is enabled. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `has_discussions` | boolean | Whether discussions are enabled. Default: `false`. Example: `true`. |
| `team_id` | integer | The id of the team that will be granted access to this repository. **Only valid when creating a repository in an organization.** |
| `auto_init` | boolean | Whether the repository is initialized with a minimal README. Default: `false`. |
| `gitignore_template` | string | The desired language or platform to apply to the `.gitignore`. Example: `"Haskell"`. |
| `license_template` | string | The license keyword of the open source license for this repository. Example: `"mit"`. |
| `allow_squash_merge` | boolean | Whether to allow squash merges for pull requests. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `allow_merge_commit` | boolean | Whether to allow merge commits for pull requests. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `allow_rebase_merge` | boolean | Whether to allow rebase merges for pull requests. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `allow_auto_merge` | boolean | Whether to allow Auto-merge to be used on pull requests. Default: `false`. Example: `false`. |
| `delete_branch_on_merge` | boolean | Whether to delete head branches when pull requests are merged. Default: `false`. Example: `false`. |
| `squash_merge_commit_title` | string | Allowed values: `PR_TITLE`, `COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE`. Required when using `squash_merge_commit_message`. |
| `squash_merge_commit_message` | string | Allowed values: `PR_BODY`, `COMMIT_MESSAGES`, `BLANK`. |
| `merge_commit_title` | string | Allowed values: `PR_TITLE`, `MERGE_MESSAGE`. Required when using `merge_commit_message`. |
| `merge_commit_message` | string | Allowed values: `PR_BODY`, `PR_TITLE`, `BLANK`. |
| `has_downloads` | boolean | Whether downloads are enabled. Default: `true`. Example: `true`. |
| `is_template` | boolean | Whether this repository acts as a template that can be used to generate new repositories. Default: `false`. Example: `true`. |

## Request Body Example

```json
{
  "name": "Hello-World",
  "description": "This is your first repo!",
  "homepage": "https://github.com",
  "private": false,
  "is_template": true
}
```

## Sample Request

```bash
curl -i --location --request POST 'https://api.github.com/user/repos' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "Hello-World",
    "description": "This is your first repo!",
    "homepage": "https://github.com",
    "private": false,
    "is_template": true
  }'
```

## Example Usage

### Example 1: Create a private repository initialized with a README

```bash
curl -i --location --request POST 'https://api.github.com/user/repos' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "internal-tools",
    "private": true,
    "auto_init": true
  }'
```

### Example 2: Create a public repository with a .gitignore and license template

```bash
curl -i --location --request POST 'https://api.github.com/user/repos' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "data-pipeline",
    "gitignore_template": "Haskell",
    "license_template": "mit",
    "private": false
  }'
```

### Example 3: Configure merge behavior defaults

```bash
curl -i --location --request POST 'https://api.github.com/user/repos' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "name": "merge-policy-demo",
    "allow_squash_merge": true,
    "squash_merge_commit_title": "PR_TITLE",
    "squash_merge_commit_message": "PR_BODY",
    "allow_merge_commit": true,
    "merge_commit_title": "PR_TITLE",
    "merge_commit_message": "PR_BODY",
    "allow_rebase_merge": true,
    "allow_auto_merge": false,
    "delete_branch_on_merge": false
  }'
```

## Behavior

1. Validates the request body (notably that `name` is present).
2. Creates the repository under the authenticated user account with the provided settings.
3. Returns the created repository object and a `Location` response header.

## Notes

- Request body content type is `application/json`.
- `team_id` is documented as only valid when creating a repository in an organization.

## Gotchas

- `squash_merge_commit_title` is required when using `squash_merge_commit_message`.
- `merge_commit_title` is required when using `merge_commit_message`.
- The endpoint may return **422** for validation failures or if the endpoint has been spammed.

## Error Handling

- **400 Bad Request**: Malformed request.
- **401 Requires authentication**: Missing/invalid authentication.
- **403 Forbidden**: Authenticated but not allowed.
- **404 Resource not found**: Resource/endpoint not available in the current context.
- **422 Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.**: Validation errors; see `errors[]` in response.
